title: Closing sheet over a held footer, with credits under a lifting stage
summary: The page's last sheet (ground and wordmark) slides off a footer stage that sticks inside a rail starting `50svh` above it, tipping `−5°` on its top-left corner on a scrub from the moment the stage sticks to `max`; the stage's content rises `12 % → 0` as the sheet's foot clears. A Site credits button scrolls to the end (`.8 s`) while it lifts the stage by the credits' own height plus what the tilt drops at the corner and tilts it `−5°` on one `1 s` expo-out transition to uncover a colophon beneath; Escape, a real close button or a scroll past `24 px` after a `.85 s` arming delay put it back, focus returns to the trigger, and the panel is `inert` and hidden while closed. Footer links blink by a registered GSAP effect (hard opacity steps at `.06 s`). Reduced motion: nothing tips or lifts, the credits fade up over the stage; static: a cut
variants: credits under a lifting stage (this, default)
a contact form or a newsletter under the stage instead of credits, same open, close and focus rules
no stage lift: the closing sheet alone tips off a held footer, for a page with no colophon
